name: Device Pairing
description: Generate setup codes and approve device pairing requests.

publicUrl.label: Gateway URL
publicUrl.help: Public WebSocket URL used for /pair setup codes (ws/wss or http/https).

recommendedPrompts: Help me connect a device to this OpenClaw Gateway. Ask which device and connection method I intend to use, explain the pairing steps and requested permissions, and guide me through the supported setup flow. Keep any short-lived code private and ask before issuing a code or approving a device.

Help me review any pending device-pairing requests. Explain the device identity and requested capabilities for each request I am authorized to inspect, and ask me to verify the device before making a decision. Do not approve or reject any request automatically.
